operation.title: Operation
enumTitles: Extract subtitles from the full frame (OCR)
Check a video or subtitle job
operation.description: Choose what to produce or check a job you already submitted.

input.title: Media URL or job ID
input.description: For a new job, supply a directly downloadable HTTPS media URL. To check an existing job, enter only its numeric ID.

source.title: Source language
source.description: OCR: language visible in the frame. Dubbing: spoken language. Image translation: language printed on the image.

target.title: Target language
target.description: Used for dubbing and image translation. Ignored for erasure, OCR and status checks.

submit.title: Submit a billable media job
submit.description: Off previews a creation request without sending it. Status checks only retrieve the existing job.

requestKey.title: Request key for Store billing
requestKey.description: For Apify Store billing, use a stable key for this file and operation, such as episode-001-ocr. It prevents a retry from creating a second billable job. Leave empty when using your own Weydub credentials.

waitForResult.title: Wait for my download link
waitForResult.description: For submissions using your Weydub credits. Keep this run open while the file is processing. If it takes longer, the dataset gives you the original job ID to check later. Waiting uses Apify runtime.

appKey.title: Your Weydub AppKey
appKey.description: Required when submitting or checking a job. Not needed for preview.

appSecret.title: Your Weydub AppSecret
appSecret.description: Use the secret for your own Weydub API account. Never put this in the media URL.
